summary: Walks a linked list starting at the head pointer stored in this+0x20, keeping the current walk position in this+0x28. Every node's first DWORD is tested by FieldCompareConstant; the walk returns 0 as soon as a node fails the comparison (user cancel detected), and returns 1 when the list is empty, exhausted, or every node passes.

local_names.v2: list head pointer read from this+0x20

operations.description: Read the list head pointer from this+0x20 and initialize the walk position this+0x28 to it.
If the head pointer is NULL, return 1 immediately (empty list; no cancel detected).
If the head node's first DWORD is 0, return 1 (list considered complete).
While FieldCompareConstant(current node's first DWORD) is non-zero, keep walking the list; the comparison result selects the terminal return.
FieldCompareConstant tests whether the node's first field matches the expected constant; called from this walk and, per the packet, this function is itself invoked from sub_4B9000.
Advance the walk position: this+0x28 becomes the next-pointer stored at offset +4 of the current node.
If the next node pointer is NULL or its first DWORD is 0, return 1 (end of list reached without detecting a cancel).
Return 0 when FieldCompareConstant is FALSE, meaning a node failed the comparison and a user cancel is detected.
